name: blueprint/meal-planner
description: Recipes become a plan: store recipes, extract ingredients, build the grocery list, schedule prep events, deliver through reminders
recipe: store the recipe -> extract the ingredient list -> append to the grocery list (prefix-scan inventory) -> schedule prep events and let the due check deliver
pitfalls: the grocery list is a prefix scan - one key per item
a bought item is a state flip on the key, not a delete (keep the list honest)
